summary: Vista Credit Strategic Lending Corp. filed an 8-K to disclose unregistered sales of its Class I and Class S common stock, with 79,052.314 Class I shares and 68,125.960 Class S shares issued as of June 1, 2026, finalized June 22, 2026, for total consideration of $2,808,500. The sales were made via subscription agreements to accredited investors or non-U.S. persons, exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D or S. Additionally, the company reported a preliminary NAV per share of $19.08 as of May 31, 2026, with total investments of $1.9 billion and a 0.83x debt-to-equity ratio. This is a routine capital raise and NAV update, not a special situation.
